name: sift_down_range
declaration: unsafe fn sift_down_range (& mut self , pos : usize , end : usize) -> usize
documentation:
Take an element at `pos` and move it down the heap,
 while its children are larger.

 Returns the new position of the element.

 # Safety

 The caller must guarantee that `pos < end <= self.len()`.
rules: The caller must guarantee that `pos < end <= self.len()` when calling `sift_down_range`.
